subject.title: [Feature]: Interactive ticket bridge for standalone MCP App host

question: Should the ticketed standalone host gain the same narrowly scoped owning-server tool and resource operations as a fresh Control UI view, under the existing live-view policy, before any channel launcher exposes it?
rationale: The request adds authority across a browser-facing ticket boundary; maintainers must confirm that sharing the authenticated Control UI policy is the intended permanent security contract.

options.title: Sponsor the shared-policy bridge
options.body: Authorize a focused implementation that reuses the canonical Control UI operation policy and preserves ticket-bound revalidation for every request.

options.title: Keep standalone read-only
options.body: Retain the current least-privilege host until a future launcher design establishes a different reviewed authority model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shared-policy bridge
recommendation.body: Authorize a focused implementation that reuses the canonical Control UI operation policy and preserves ticket-bound revalidation for every request.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the two directly adjacent merged MCP App bridge surfaces and is the issue author proposing the follow-on boundary.
